ja: • 『機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN IV 運命の前夜』より「ガンキャノン最初期型」がキット化！
• 左肩部の武装は差し替え式で、ミサイルランチャーとキャノン砲を再現可能！
• “スミス海の戦い”を再現する各種武装も付属！柔軟な可動でキャノン発射ポーズをとらせることもできる！
en: • "Guncannon earliest type" from "Mobile Suit Gundam THE ORIGIN IV: Eve of Fate" is now a kit!
• The armament on the left shoulder is replaceable, allowing you to recreate the missile launcher and cannon!
• Various weapons to recreate the “Battle of the Smith Sea” are also included! Flexible movement allows you to pose with a cannon firing!
